question: Which of the following beaches has become the first in Asia to get the Blue Flag certification?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandrabhaga beach**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandrabhaga beach** has become the first beach in Asia to receive the Blue Flag certification.
 
• The Blue Flag certification is a globally recognized eco-label awarded to beaches, marinas, and sustainable boating tourism operators.
 
• To earn this certification, beaches must meet stringent environmental, educational, safety, and accessibility criteria.
 
• The certification is awarded by the Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE), which is a non-governmental organization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandrabhaga beach** is located in the state of Odisha, India.
 
• It is renowned for its scenic beauty and cultural significance, being close to the UNESCO World Heritage site of Konark Sun Temple.
 
• The Blue Flag certification aims to promote sustainable development in freshwater and marine areas through stringent criteria dealing with water quality, environmental management, and safety.
 
• India is committed to enhancing the environmental quality of its beaches and promoting sustainable tourism practices.
